mina: Quick follow-up from the midnight KV OOM. Root cause looks like small-object churn + slab fragmentation after shard-sync. Short action items below, please claim.

mina: Actions:
1) soft eviction canary (temp) -> owner: ? -> ETA: 4h
2) 3-host heap captures + flamegraphs -> owner: ? -> ETA: 24h
3) provisional metric `kv.frag_index` -> owner: ? -> ETA: 6h
4) pointer-safety grep of shard-sync commit -> owner: ? -> ETA: 48h

ryan: I'll take (1). will flip `kv.eviction.soft_pct=85` in canary, smoke test, rollback if p99 > baseline+20%. ETA 2h.

sara: I'll do (2) and (4) pairing with ryan after captures. plan: run `heap-capture --secs=90` on nodes alpha/beta/gamma and run quick grep for unsafe casts. ETA 18h.

ryan: added small log event `EVT:kv.soft_evict shard=%s pct=%d` and smoke script. starting canary now.

ops-bot: [automated] Created ticket INF-7002 "KV slab fragmentation follow-up" link: https://issue.redwood/INF-7002

sara: (3) mina, can you own the metric? `kv.frag_index = free_frag_bytes / active_bytes` sample 15s; low-sev alert if >0.25 for 10m.

mina: on it. will add dashboard and tag ticket. reconvene in 24h.
